jobs.occupation: Order Picker in 2 Shifts – Join a Leading International Logistics Team
jobs.description:
As an order picker working in two shifts, you’ll be responsible for efficiently collecting orders in the warehouse. You’ll work along the order picking line, carefully placing the correct products into boxes according to the foreman’s daily briefing. Your attention to detail ensures that orders leave the warehouse correctly and on time.

A typical workday starts with a team meeting where daily goals are discussed. You’ll then get to work picking orders, maintaining a clean and safe workspace at all times. You’ll collaborate with colleagues but are also able to work independently and keep calm during busy periods.

If you’re eager to learn, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a growing international company, apply now and discover the opportunities this role has to offer!

• Strong motivation, regardless of educational background

• Precise working style with great attention to detail

• Able to handle stress and perform well in a busy environment

• Blend of team spirit and independence

• Eager to learn and open to discovering new aspects of the production department

• Maintain a clean and safe workspace

• Fluent in Dutch and/or English

• Preferably 1 to 5 years of relevant experience

As a truck driver you are responsible to deliver and collect goods to our customers. You make collections and deliveries in all parts of Benelux or European countries. You report to the dispatching team.

 

 

You have C or CE and ADR driving license (with valid code 95).

You have a least 2 years of experience in driving with semi-trailers and are familiar with highways within BENELUX and west EU countries.

You speak Dutch (Flemish), French or English fluently. Any other European language is a plus.

You have your own car.

As a forklift/reach truck driver at DHL Supply Chain, your tasks will include the following:
 

 
• You will be responsible for picking up and placing pallets in height (up to 12m) in the warehouse.
 
• You will work with a computer system that indicates when to place or pick up a pallet.
 
• You will also be responsible for unloading/loading trucks and/or containers.
 
• Single deep or double deep reaching with camera is a plus.
 
• You are willing to perform warehouse tasks (not 100% lift or reach truck). 

As a forklift/reachtruck at DHL you can fully identify yourself with the following description:
 

 
• You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English.
 
• You are in possession of a reachtruck or forklift certificate and you have relevant experience.
 
• You have a good physical condition
 
• You can reach the workplace in Bornem on time and with your own transportation.
 
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts (6h-14h/14h-22h)
 
• You are accurate, independent and flexible.
 
• Experience single deep or double deep reaching with camera is a plus.

To strengthen our Product Compliance team, we are looking for a Business Support Assistant who enjoys working with data, coordinating information across different stakeholders, and ensuring that products meet sustainability and regulatory requirements in an international environment.
Jobomschrijving

Your mission

 

As a Business Support Assistant within the Product Compliance team, you will help ensure that our products comply with environmental, material and sustainability requirements requested by customers and regulatory authorities worldwide.

You will act as a key support partner by managing information, analyzing data, coordinating requests and contributing to regulatory reporting activities.

Training and support will be provided to help you develop your expertise in the compliance domain.

 

What will you do?

 

Manage and analyze product information

· Maintain and update product and material information databases.

· Ensure data accuracy, consistency and availability for internal teams.

· Perform checks and analyses to support compliance activities.

· Prepare and consolidate reports used for internal decision-making and customer requests.

Support customer and sustainability requirements

· Contribute to the completion of customer questionnaires, assessments and compliance-related requests.

· Gather, verify and organize the necessary information within agreed deadlines.

· Support sustainability reporting activities linked to materials and environmental requirements.

Contribute to product compliance activities

· Support compliance checks regarding material and environmental regulations.

· Monitor and collect relevant regulatory information.

· Help ensure that product-related documentation remains accurate and up to date.

· Participate in continuous improvement of processes and tools used by the team.

Collaborate across teams

· Work closely with colleagues from engineering, quality, purchasing and customer-facing functions.

· Act as a reliable point of contact for information requests related to compliance activities.

· Coordinate information from multiple stakeholders in an international environment.

 

Your profile

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

· First experience in administrative support, data management, reporting, quality, compliance or a similar business support role.

· Comfortable working with large volumes of information and data.

· Strong analytical and organizational skills.

· Good command of Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

· Fluent in English and French. Knowledge of Japanese is an asset.

 

Your strengths

· Detail-oriented and rigorous.

· Able to manage priorities and meet deadlines.

· Proactive and solution-focused.

· Comfortable working independently while collaborating with different stakeholders.

· Curious and eager to learn new topics and regulations.

As an Operator, you operate computer-controlled production machines, keeping the process efficient and high-quality. You set machine parameters, perform quality checks, and make sure the final product is packaged correctly.
A typical day? Setting up machines, following up on planning, and performing quality controls. You work together with colleagues to achieve the best results.
Do you see yourself in this role? Apply now and strengthen the team as an Operator!

• You have some experience in a production environment
• You speak Dutch or English
• Shifts are no problem for you! This can be in fixed night, 3-shift, or continuous shift systems.

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

Wat ga je doen?                
Are you technically minded and ready for a varied job in a production environment? Discover your opportunities as an Assembly Worker in a two-shift system.As an Assembly Worker, you play an essential role in the production of seating solutions, such as car seats, for one of our clients. You will start with an intensive training programme where you will learn various assembly techniques, allowing you to develop into a skilled specialist.Your responsibilities:- Assembling car seat components according to technical instructions.- Covering seat cushions with fabric or leather.- Performing visual quality checks on finished products.- Identifying and reporting errors or defects.You will work in a two-shift system and become part of a production environment where you can continuously learn and develop your skills.
                Wie ben jij?                                                                                        
• You have technical insight, from your school background, previous work experiences, or from a technical hobby.                                                                                                
• You can handle the heat well, as you'll be working in a warm environment.                                                                                                
• You're eager to learn and ready to get your hands dirty.                                                                                                
Opleiding: A technical education is a plus, but not required.
                                                    
Vakkennis: You have some initial experience in assembly.
                                                    
Talenkennis: You have a good knowledge of Dutch or a good knowledge of English. Either one is enough!
                                                    
Attesten: /
                                Wat bieden wij jou?                                                                                        
• You start with an hourly wage of €17.3549.                                                                                                
• On top of that, you get a shift bonus of 13%!                                                                                                
• Plus, you get plenty of extra perks, like meal vouchers.                                                            
.

As a machine operator in our modern citrus department, you play a crucial role in operating and optimizing automated production and packaging lines. You use MES software to monitor and improve the performance of machines and production lines. Together with your team, you ensure a smooth workflow and high-quality end products.

Your day consists of setting up, adjusting, and operating machines, timely providing materials, and guiding colleagues on the line. You work closely with the technical department in case of malfunctions and regularly perform minor maintenance tasks. Additionally, you register production data and help maintain order and cleanliness in the workplace.

Are you a team player who likes to take initiative and think about improvements? Do you want to work in a growing department within a stable company? Apply now and discover your opportunities as a machine operator in our citrus department!

• At least lower secondary education
• Experience as an operator is required (0-1 year welcome)
• Good knowledge of English (spoken and written)
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (sometimes three shifts) and weekends
• Team-oriented and communicative
• Accurate and safety-conscious
• Proactive and solution-oriented

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to work in a 2-shift system. You will help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machinery and equipment park, while having the opportunity to further develop your technical skills.
 

You will work in a 2-shift system from 06:00 to 14:00 and from 14:00 to 22:00.
 

Your tasks and responsibilities
 

 
• As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your technical expertise, you will help keep production processes reliable and minimise downtime.
 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
 
• Troubleshooting and resolving electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.
 
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical failures.
 
• Analysing faults and identifying sustainable solutions.
 
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.
 
• Actively contributing to optimisations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machinery.
 
• Working closely with the production department to minimise downtime.
 
• Working in accordance with applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.
 
• Contributing to a clean, safe and orderly working environment. 

 
• You have a technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation or a similar technical field. Relevant practical experience can also be considered.
 
• You have experience in maintaining and repairing industrial machinery.
 
• You have knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop your skills internally.
 
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but not a requirement.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You are able to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, while also being able to carry out technical interventions independently.

You will work in a two-shift system:

No two days will be quite the same. You'll combine day-to-day HR responsibilities with practical health, safety and well-being coordination. 

HR – People & Organisation 
 
· Manage recruitment, interviews and onboarding of new colleagues.
 
· Coordinate payroll, absences, contracts and personnel administration.
 
· Be the first point of contact for employees' HR questions.
 
· Organise training and keep employee records up to date.
 
· Help improve HR processes as the team grows.
 
EHS – Health, Safety & Well-being
 
· Coordinate workplace safety and well-being activities with external prevention specialists.
 
· Follow up on safety procedures, risk assessments and preventive actions.
 
· Organise safety inductions, mandatory training and occupational health appointments.
 
· Maintain EHS documentation and follow up on workplace incidents.
 
· Help create a safe, well-organised working environment.
 
You won't be expected to be an EHS expert from day one. Your organisational skills, initiative and willingness to learn are what matter most.
 
 

· A Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in HR or a related field. 

· Around 3 years of relevant HR experience, ideally combining administration, payroll support and recruitment.
 
· A working knowledge of Belgian HR administration and employment legislation.
 
· Excellent English, essential for communication with international colleagues.
 
· French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
 
· A practical, organised and independent approach.
 
· An interest in workplace safety and well-being.
 
Above all, you're someone who takes initiative, enjoys helping colleagues and feels comfortable in a small, fast-moving team.
 
Work authorisation: Applicants must currently reside in Belgium and already have the legal right to work in Belgium. Please note that visa or work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

jobs.occupation: Lead Contract Engineer Nuclear Pressure Equipment (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As a Lead Contract Engineer (M/F/X), you will be the point of contact for our customers. You build a relationship of trust with the customer and provide tailored advice for the assessment of the construction/design of nuclear pressure equipment according to various construction codes and standards. You maintain regular contact with your customers and also carry out inspections yourself. You are responsible for following up projects from A to Z, from quotation and design through to actual execution and invoicing. In addition, you are also the point of contact for the inspectors on site.
  
 
  
You can always rely on your colleagues: driven experts who are happy to help you further.
  
Vinçotte also supports you in deepening and broadening your expertise. We start this on your very first day, as you will first receive thorough training and an internship before working independently.

  
• Degree: You have a Master's degree in Industrial Sciences – Electromechanics. A Welding Engineer degree is a strong asset.  
• Experience: You preferably have around five years of experience in the maintenance/inspection of pressure equipment.  
• Skills:  
•      
• You are eager to learn and keep up to date with trends and developments in your field.   
• You have a sense of quality and an eye for detail.   
• You show initiative and enjoy customer contact.   
• You work independently and in a disciplined manner.   
• You speak fluent Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of English (both written and spoken).    
• You are communicative and entrepreneurial, with a sense of initiative and organization.

jobs.occupation: Internship - Digitalization & AI for Wiper Blade Testing
jobs.description:
Your challenge

Join our wiper blade test department and help us make our testing processes smarter, more standardized and data-driven. You will work on practical digitalization and AI solutions together with our test engineers.

Your main tasks

• Test specification standardization
• Compare existing wiper blade test specifications and identify opportunities for complexity reduction.
• Standardize test descriptions and required information.
• Develop an AI-based solution to easily compare specifications and highlight differences.
• AI for test reports
• Develop an AI solution to search and analyze historical test reports.
• Investigate how the quality and structure of existing data can be improved.
• Create a standardized template for future test reports to enable effective AI-based analysis.
• Digitalization of test equipment
• Update the test equipment inventory, including equipment locations.
• Support the preparation and entry of equipment data into the new laboratory management system planned for 2027.
• Wiper arm digitalization & 3D scanning
• Create an inventory of available wiper arms and link them to the existing wiper arm library.
• Support the digitalization of wiper arms using 3D scanning.

• Bachelor or Master student with a technical/engineering background, for example mechanical, automotive, electromechanical or industrial engineering.
• A strong interest in digitalization and Artificial Intelligence.
• An analytical and structured way of working.
• Motivation to work with technical specifications, test reports and engineering data.
• Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with test engineers.
• Good written and spoken English, as you will work with technical specifications, reports and colleagues in an international environment.

jobs.occupation: Internship in the field of Lean Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Depending on your study program the internship may contain the following main points:

• Support the design of new production machines and processes.
• Participation in Bosch Production System projects: continuous improvement work on existing production and/or logistic processes the fields of Safety, Quality, Cost & Delivery.
• Standardization and improvement of production and/or logistics processes.
• Definition & implementation of lean standards: value stream planning, standardized work, pull production, leveling, quick changeover, …
• I4.0 and digitalization.
Preferred start date:February - March

You must be enrolled as a student.

• Language: good knowledge of English is required. German and possibly Dutch is a plus.
• Fields of study: mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, production engineering, technical business economics.

• Good knowledge of MS-Office.
• You are able to communicate efficient & effective, you can work on your own and as a team player.
